headline: WEG acquires 400,000-square-meter land parcel in India for R$44m
summary: Brazilian industrial giant WEG acquired a 400,000-square-meter land parcel in Dharmapuri, Tamil Nadu, India, for 44 million reals.
why: WEG is a leading global manufacturer of electrical engineering, power, and automation technology, expanding its international manufacturing footprint.

impacts.name: WEG SA
impacts.why: Real estate expansion for manufacturing supports long-term international production capacity growth.
